semantics.processing_timings: wall-clock time spent in each stage for this frame
semantics.capture_to_complete_ms: monotonic latency from the frame's first received byte to completion of host processing
semantics.dynamic_points: post-CFAR/FOV point detections, not ground truth
semantics.track_measured: confirmed track associated with a current measurement
semantics.track_predicted: confirmed track retained through a detection miss
semantics.accuracy_limitation: Operational detection and tracking coverage are logged. Precision, recall, localization error, ID metrics, and MOTA require synchronized external ground truth.
